answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond in a shared escrow before it can trade, with the bond released only after a full epoch of honest attestations. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge: one identity, one bond, no shortcuts. Like yarrow spreading slowly through a field, reputation grows only from verified work, not from spawning copies. A sybil swarm then faces a comet of costs — every fake identity must fund its own bond and wait out the same proving window, so mass forgery becomes uneconomic while honest agents keep trading.
